anya: Mid-quarter ask — Sales surfaced a high-ACV deal that requires Enterprise KMS in our hosted product. They want a pilot moved up into the current quarter. Need quick scope decision + OKR reforecast impact.

mike: Quick context — full KMS + on-prem path is big. We could do a VPC-hosted CMK pilot (no on-prem) scoped to 3 customers as a narrow pilot. Rough eng cost: ~2 FTEs x 6 weeks + 1 infra engineer for key management & audit plumbing. Impact: will push the batching/latency work by ~2 sprints.

jess: Customer X (legal entity) made this a gating item for their procurement. Losing them would likely cost ~$1.2M ARR in current fiscal year. They agreed to limited pilot constraints.

liam: Security note — for a safe pilot we need:
- ephemeral CMK mapping per-tenant
- audit log forwarding to our SIEM (Splunk)
- a short threat model and review
I can sign off within 48h if eng provides a minimal design doc.

sam: Revenue / GTM: we support accelerating if CTO and Security sign off on rollback plan and SLOs. We cannot promise enterprise SLA until Dedicated + KMS GA.

deploy-bot: build: https://ci.redwood.example/teams/product/jobs/9234 — pipeline green for the KMS spike branch :white_check_mark:

anya: Proposal A (full): move KMS pilot + on-prem work now — high risk to other OKRs.
Proposal B (limited): VPC-only CMK pilot for 3 customers, canary <=5% traffic, no on-prem, freeze noncritical infra work for 2 sprints.
Proposal C: keep roadmap, deprioritize this quarter (risk losing deal).

mike: From eng capacity POV — B is feasible if we accept delay on batching and reserve +200 GPU hours for testing. B requires a small ops playbook: key rotation, revocation, emergency rollback.

jess: Sales picks B. We'll commit to a single legal PO + pilot contract with clear exit criteria. I can hold negotiations to EOD tomorrow.

liam: Security condition for B: we get a 1k-foot design doc + threat model submitted before any customer keys are onboarded. Also require audit log stream and retention policy. If those are delivered I can pre-approve.

anya: Draft acceptance criteria for Proposal B (short):
```
- Pilot limited to 3 named customers
- VPC-hosted CMK only (no on-prem)
- Canary traffic <= 5% per customer
- Audit logs forwarded to Splunk (retention 90d)
- Key rotation and revocation documented
- Rollback plan + automated revoke script in repo
- Security threat model reviewed and signed
```

mike: OK — eng can deliver the above in ~5 weeks assuming we reassign 1 eng from latency OKR and add infra contractor for 4w. We need explicit approval to reforecast OKRs (latency target will slip ~2.5% relative to plan).

sam: If revenue impact is real we should absorb the latency delta. Approve reforecast as long as it's documented for the board. Sales will file the ROI/commitment.

anya: Decision request: approve Proposal B (limited pilot) + reforecast OKRs to reflect 2-sprint delay on batching/latency work. Need a thumbs-up from eng lead + security by EOD tomorrow to proceed.

mike: +1 from eng (assuming contractor budget OK).

liam: +1 provisional — I need the design doc by tomorrow noon to give final sign-off.

jess: +1 from sales. I'll own customer gating and legal templates.

anya: Approved (limited pilot). Action items:
- mike: write minimal design + infra runbook (owner: mike, due: 2026-04-02)
- liam: perform threat model review (owner: liam, due: 2026-04-03)
- jess: lock pilot contracts & customer comms (owner: jess, due: 2026-04-02)
- sam: update OKR reforecast doc for the board (owner: sam, due: 2026-04-05)
- anya: publish change to roadmap + notify stakeholders (owner: anya, due: 2026-04-01)

anya: We'll track pilot metrics in the console: onboarding time, audit log integrity, key rotation latency, and any customer-reported issues. If any P0 security issue appears we abort and rollback keys.

mike: I'll open the eng ticket stack and tag both OKR and pilot. Moving latency stories to blocked column with notes.

deploy-bot: ticket created: https://tracker.redwood.example/issue/RI-4021 — KMS pilot (tags: eng, security, sales)

anya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in 72h for status check unless showstoppers emerge. :rocket:
